# manifested as type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:manifestedAsType`](gmeow-manifestedAsType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/manifestedAsType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

The feared kind of event — what this hazard's manifestation would BE, were it to occur. Range is [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md), never [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md): the type level is where counterfactuals live without machinery. NOT functional, at least one (SHACL): a hazard may threaten several manifestation kinds.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Hazard`](../classes/gmeow-Hazard.md) -> [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:manifestedAsType`](gmeow-manifestedAsType.md) from [`gmeow:Hazard`](../classes/gmeow-Hazard.md) to [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
